scope: MIT covers original project contributions only. Project file paths are current; game addition and edit paths describe the audited snapshot, whose additions now live in client/. This inventory does not clear compiled ROMs, patches, dependencies or images.
migration_policy: Include only the exact project_files and game_additions paths; exclude every unlisted path in every historical tree.
Relocate original game additions outside the ignored upstream workspace. Recreate shared-file edits with reviewed project changes; do not export complete modified upstream files or binary assets.
Preserve authors, dates and messages with an original-to-migrated commit map. Keep the complete original repository and PR history private.
Review newly added paths and copied content before extending the allowlist; a directory name or file extension does not prove ownership.
Check all reachable public history, tags, source archives, artifact layers and secret exposure before publication.

components.name: Original project server, tests, tooling and guidance
components.requirements: Keep the MIT notice. Current server tests use synthetic HTTP/configuration data, not game saves or Pokemon payload fixtures.

components.name: Original Wonder Trade application, networking and text additions
components.requirements: Preserve attribution; shared upstream files and compiled game/SDK material are not covered.

components.name: Imported Platinum source, graphics, maps, text, audio and game data
components.requirements: Keep local/private. The snapshot includes thousands of graphics and data files, binary maps, MIDI and WAV assets; a project MIT license does not clear them.

components.name: Nintendo support libraries fetched by upstream
components.requirements: These wrappers identify pinned external inputs, not redistribution grants. Do not vendor SDK/library source or generated binaries into public source, caches or images.

components.name: Metroskrew 0.1.3 and relinked compiler binaries
components.requirements: The upstream project identifies a relinked proprietary Metrowerks compiler. Download availability is not a redistribution grant; establish permitted toolchain use before release builds and never publish its binaries.

components.name: Imported Diamond and Pearl source, graphics, maps, text, audio and game data
components.requirements: Keep local/private in game/pokediamond/. The integration patch and project additions in client/ are reviewed project changes; complete modified upstream files, assets and ROM output are not covered.

components.name: Metrowerks CodeWarrior compiler binaries used by pokediamond (mwccarm.zip)
components.requirements: Proprietary Metrowerks compilers, linkers and license files fetched by checksum into a local build image and the workspace's ignored tools/. Download availability is not a redistribution grant; establish permitted toolchain use before release builds and never publish its binaries, the image or its layers.

components.name: Nitro SDK 3.2 tools and linker templates used by pokediamond (NitroSDK-3_2-060901.7z)
components.requirements: Only the SDK's Windows tools and ARM7/ARM9 linker templates are extracted into the local image and the ignored workspace. Download availability is not a redistribution grant; establish permitted use before release builds and never publish SDK source, headers, tools, the image or its layers. The declarations in client/include/wonder_trade/dp/ cover only what the shared core calls and are written from the game's assembly and documented SDK behavior, not copied from SDK headers.

components.name: CodeWarrior MSL C headers from the Metroskrew 0.1.3 release
components.requirements: Freescale/Metrowerks MSL C headers, extracted by checksum into the local Diamond/Pearl build image only to compile the Wonder Trade core and Mbed TLS. Download availability is not a redistribution grant; establish permitted toolchain use before release builds and never publish the headers, the image or its layers.

components.name: Fetched game build dependencies: RapidJSON 1.1.0, yyjson 0.12.0, metang v0.2.0-python and Meson 1.12.0
components.license: RapidJSON: MIT plus BSD/JSON components; yyjson: MIT; metang and Meson: Apache-2.0
components.requirements: Keep these external to project source. Before distributing tools or build images, retain their notices and review included components and Meson wrap patches. RapidJSON's bin/jsonchecker uses the JSON license; exclude it from distributions unless separately reviewed.

components.name: Bundled upstream tools and embedded libraries
components.license: per-component; not covered by project MIT
components.requirements: Retain local notices: nitrogfx and pugixml/cJSON MIT, nitrosfx LGPL 2.1 license document, nitrobtx GPL-3.0-only headers, optparse Unlicense. Do a per-file source/binary obligations review before separately redistributing any tool.

components.name: gRPC C++ and its transitive components
components.requirements: Inventory the exact installed version and transitive components and retain their licenses/notices in released binaries/images; the project MIT license does not replace them.

components.name: Protocol Buffers
components.requirements: Retain the runtime license in binary distributions. Generated code ownership follows the input schema; runtime dependencies retain their own terms.

components.name: Boost
components.requirements: Retain applicable notices in source redistribution and review the exact packaged binary dependencies.

components.name: GoogleTest
components.requirements: Keep notices if redistributed; do not package test/build inputs into the runtime image unnecessarily.

components.name: Ubuntu base images and build/runtime packages
components.requirements: Before GHCR publication inventory exact packages/transitive licenses, retain package copyright files and satisfy applicable source/relinking obligations. Do not copy the game workspace into a public image.

components.name: Mbed TLS 4.1.1 with TF-PSA-Crypto 1.2.0
components.license: Apache-2.0 (selected from dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later)
components.requirements: Preserve upstream source notices and the selected Apache license. Only the bounded profile is linked; no TLS source is vendored. Inventory exact linked objects and transitive notices in the final patch audit before distribution.

components.name: PostgreSQL 16 / libpq
components.requirements: Runtime packages retain their PostgreSQL license/copyright files, including /usr/share/doc/libpq5/copyright. Inventory exact package versions and transitive notices before publishing images; no PostgreSQL source is vendored.

components.name: PKHeX.Core 26.08.26 isolated legality service
components.requirements: Build from the hash-verified immutable source archive, selecting only Core plus its build properties and license. Preserve the complete matching core/resources and adapter/build source in every runtime image and supply it with distributions. No UI/artwork/package icon or upstream binary fixtures are selected. Review all 1,731 embedded core tables, text and event resources in the final image rights audit; the upstream GPL declaration alone does not independently prove provenance for game-derived content. Retain gRPC/Protobuf/base-image notices and exact dependency hashes.

components.name: OpenSSL 3 libcrypto for server identity verification
components.requirements: Use the Ubuntu security-maintained libssl package and retain /usr/share/doc/libssl3t64/copyright in runtime images. Review exact versions and transitive notices before publication. No OpenSSL source is vendored.

components.name: melonDS 1.1 durable Linux emulator integration
components.license: GPL-3.0-or-later for upstream/combined emulator; MIT for original persistence/tool additions
components.requirements: Preserve the upstream GPL context/license and all component notices. Supply the complete exact upstream, integration patch, added MIT persistence/capability source, build scripts and project license with any binary distribution; review Qt/SDL/ENet/SLIRP/OpenSSL and packaged dependencies for notices/source or relinking obligations before publication. No ROM, BIOS, firmware, save or private state belongs in source, CI artifacts or container layers.

release_allowlist: Reviewed checksum-specific BPS patches without ROMs or unrelated original game content
Supported input/output checksum and compatibility manifests
Project/dependency licenses, required notices and corresponding source

publication_blockers.requirement: Only allowlisted project source/history may enter the replacement repository; remove inherited game/SDK/assets and audit every reachable tree.

Reconstruct the game locally from pinned upstream input and reviewed changes without publishing imported source, SDKs, proprietary toolchain binaries or private user files; establish permitted toolchain use.

Pinned source integration and GPL source/notice handling are implemented by the validator. Final embedded-resource provenance, exact image contents and corresponding-source distribution remain publication gates under LUNE-315 and LUNE-323.
Audit exact dependency/base-image versions, transitive licenses, notices and layers before publishing service containers.
Inspect the actual compiled patch and literal/embedded content; patch format and input checksums alone do not establish distribution rights.
Audit final reachable Git history, archives, containers and release artifacts for rights, secrets, copied/private material and preserved notices before publication.
